paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Credit Analyst role. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Mercury's card program interests me because underwriting startups on cash and revenue data takes judgment about the business behind the numbers, and it ties directly to the cash flow work I've done.

At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows, reached 85%+ accuracy in revenue recognition and reporting through reconciliation, and helped streamline the order-to-cash process with automation, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%. In my MBA I analyzed financial statements and disclosures to assess performance and earnings quality across firms and peers.

That maps to the statement analysis, portfolio monitoring and policy feedback the role describes. I haven't underwritten credit at a bank or fintech yet, and I'd bring careful documentation habits and comfort with Excel and Python. I'd welcome the chance to talk with the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Senior Credit Analyst role at Mercury. At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of total inflows and reconciliation work with 85%+ accuracy. I'd love to hear how the team approaches cash and revenue based underwriting. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
